description: Snapshot v4 (contract 1.7.0, as 1.7.1 amends it): one shop_agent and one handoff snapshot of a submitted Shop checkout to the US, and one shop_agent snapshot to GB. checkout_ref_hash is over input.checkout_id (the part before ?), continue_url_hash over input.continue_url (handoff only), completer_keyid is gw- + the public key of completer_seed_hex and account_key_thumbprint the RFC 7638 thumbprint of account_seed_hex's key (Appendix H). invalid lists v4 snapshots a validator refuses, one rule broken in each. coarse lists coarse(country, postal_code) of Appendix A (null: no coarse code). submitted lists CheckoutRequest ship_to postcodes and whether Intent Cloud accepts them (false: 400). country_currencies lists checkouts to a country in a currency against the default table's countries (refused: the 403 code). continue_urls lists hand-off targets a checkout of that store_site and myshopify_domain allows. currency_tables gives the version of each table: ct- + the first 16 hex of SHA-256(jcs), jcs being JCS({currencies, countries}) in 1.7.1 and JCS(currencies) in 1.7.0 (the second table, no countries); the third drops FI from the countries, the fourth is the kill switch's all-zero table, the fifth a USD-only kill switch. countries is the served map: only the countries whose currency is in currencies (configured_countries, when it differs, is the configured map), and the version covers the served map. TEST KEY ONLY: published so every implementation can reproduce this vector; never use it for anything else.

invalid.name: an IE routing key with a letter it never has
a store_site with a hex last label
an IDNA top-level label with a trailing hyphen
an IDNA top-level label of hyphens
